title: The sheafified direct-sum presheaf is left adjoint to restriction to a localized site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a Grothendieck site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $W$ be an object. Give $\mathcal C/W$ the localized topology, with coverings whose underlying families cover in $\mathcal C$, and let $j_W^*:\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)$, $G\mapsto G|_W$ with $G|_W(V\xrightarrow{\varphi}W)=G(V)$, be restriction of abelian sheaves [def-sp-abelian]. For an abelian sheaf $F$ on $\mathcal C/W$ let $(j_{W,p!}F)^\#$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the direct-sum presheaf $j_{W,p!}F$ of [def-weil-pbc-site-extension-by-zero-presheaf]. Then $F\mapsto(j_{W,p!}F)^\#$ is a functor $\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ left adjoint to $j_W^*$: there are bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}((j_{W,p!}F)^\#,G)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C/W}(F,G|_W)$, natural in $F$ and $G$, under which $\alpha:F\to G|_W$ corresponds to the morphism induced, by the universal property of sheafification, by the presheaf map $j_{W,p!}F\to G$ sending $s$ in the summand $F(V\xrightarrow{\varphi}W)$ of $(j_{W,p!}F)(V)$ to $\alpha_{(V,\varphi)}(s)\in G|_W(V\xrightarrow{\varphi}W)=G(V)$.
